summary: Implemented the rich_measure feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative, explicit stack, 4 cells per level); rich/align.py constrains Align rendering to the measured maximum (or min with explicit width), adds Align.__repr__, and adds the public VerticalCenter class with render, measure, and repr; rich/console.py sets render-option justify to "default" while still passing justify into collection; CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as Unreleased with an Added section; tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py gain the requested imports and new tests (repr, VerticalCenter render/measure, tree measurement expecting (11, 19)). All changes were verified by reading only; the test suite has not been run.
